machine_originated_contract_feedback.conservative_agent_guild_recommendation: Keep trust decisions machine-readable but pair any confidence field with measured evidence support, sample size, unknowns, and a deterministic review or decline condition. Do not label an uncalibrated model maximum as trust certainty. Treat this as one machine-authored requirement signal to test against AG's existing signed-decision contract, not as sufficient evidence for a product change by itself.
